interface.name: bande_capture_v1

description.summary: what the screenshot tool needs beyond image capture

interface.description: Offered only on the connections of the shell clients the compositor starts itself. Tells the screenshot tool where the windows on the screen are, so it can highlight the one under the pointer, and when the user asks for the capture options.

request.name: list_windows

description.summary: ask where the windows on the screen are

request.description: The compositor answers with one window event per window shown on the current workspace, frontmost first, followed by windows_done.

event.name: window

description.summary: a window shown on the screen

event.description: The identifier is the one of the window's ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1. The rectangle is the window's frame, title bar included and shadow excluded, in logical output coordinates.

description.summary: every window of the last list_windows was sent

event.name: show_options

description.summary: the user pressed the capture options shortcut

event.description: Sent for Super+Shift+5, as Command-Shift-5 opens the screenshot and screen recording toolbar on a Mac.
